components.component: LLVM 23.1.1 (llvm, clang, lld, TableGen .td files, compiler-rt)
components.spdx: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception (compiler-rt also dual-licensed MIT / UIUC NCSA)
components.linking_and_translation_obligations: Permissive; LLVM-exception waives Apache-2.0 Section 4 redistribution notice requirements for binary runtime outputs (compiler-rt) linked into user programs and permits combining with GPLv2. Translating TableGen (.td) files into Lean 4 definitions is permitted with attribution.
components.counsel_flags: None for permissive Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception.

components.spdx: GPL-3.0-or-later (compiler & libgccjit.so); GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1 (libgcc_s / libstdc++ target runtimes)
components.linking_and_translation_obligations: Linking against libgccjit.so or GCC internal headers creates a combined work governed by GPLv3+. Under the GCC Runtime Library Exception v3.1, target binaries only enjoy the runtime exception if produced by an 'Eligible Compilation Process' (which forbids proprietary/GPL-incompatible compiler plugins or intermediate passes). Literal porting of GCC C++ passes requires clean-room separation to avoid GPLv3 derived-work claims.
components.counsel_flags: FLAG FOR COUNSEL: Any dynamic/static linking to libgccjit or non-clean-room porting of GCC algorithms triggers GPLv3 copyleft obligations.

components.linking_and_translation_obligations: Permissive; direct linking, fork modification, and mechanical translation of ISLE (.isle) rules or regalloc2 checker algorithms into Lean 4 are permitted under Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception.

components.spdx: INRIA Non-Commercial License (evaluation/research/education only) AND AbsInt Commercial License; select directories (lib/, common/, cfrontend/, flocq/, menhirLib/, runtime/) dual-licensed GPL-2.0-or-later OR CeCILL-C
components.linking_and_translation_obligations: CRITICAL RESTRICTION: Top-level CompCert LICENSE explicitly restricts non-dual-licensed backend/optimizations (backend/, scheduling/, x86/, aarch64/, riscv/, driver/) to non-commercial evaluation, research, or educational use unless licensed from AbsInt. Even the dual-licensed lib//common//cfrontend/ directories are copyleft (GPLv2+ or CeCILL-C), incompatible with pure Apache-2.0/MIT redistribution without copyleft propagation.
components.counsel_flags: FLAG FOR COUNSEL: Do NOT copy or mechanically translate CompCert .v/.ml files into an Apache-2.0/MIT repository; study only published academic papers (clean-room mathematical ideas).

components.spdx: BSD-3-Clause (CakeML), BSD-3-Clause (Vellvm, excluding optional CompCert-derived files if any), MIT (Alive2)

components.counsel_flags: Audit individual file headers if adapting Vellvm Coq libraries to ensure zero CompCert INRIA-non-commercial or GPLv2 contamination.
